title: HB1391 (2020 Regular Session): Retired law enforcement officers and firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by source-collector (Sonnet) from the saved official copy

operative_text:
Sec. 1 (amending IC 35-47-9-1(a)): (2) A:
(A) qualified law enforcement officer (as defined in 18 U.S.C. 926B); or
(B) qualified retired law enforcement officer (as defined in 18 U.S.C. 926C);
if the qualified law enforcement officer or qualified retired law enforcement officer carries the identification required by 18 U.S.C. 926B or 18 U.S.C. 926C.
